ecommerce_tax_scheme.name: Swiss VAT / import VAT / mail-order & platform rules
ecommerce_tax_scheme.note: Industrial tariffs are zero for most industrial goods since 2024, but import VAT, customs declaration/clearance fees, mail-order VAT, platform taxation, product safety/EPR and category-specific obligations remain.

preferred_delivery_patterns: Swiss Post preferred by 65% in 2026 survey

official_data_api: FSO/BFS PX-Web + ASTRA open vehicle data + BAZG Swiss-Impex
research_principle: Switzerland combines high purchasing power and cross-border openness with multilingual localization, strong domestic marketplaces, customs/VAT friction and demanding logistics. Large installed bases are not opportunity by default; prioritize exact lifecycle/model cells where mature neighboring source markets show deeper solutions than Swiss specialists after landed-cost/localization adjustment.
